title: PrivacyHold - Data API
description: Represents a Privacy Hold that indicates that a record should be preserved from masking or deletion by Data Management policies in Privacy Center. This object is available in API version 59.0 and later.

EndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EndDate.description: The date the Privacy Hold ends.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates if Privacy Hold is active on the record. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the Privacy Hold.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the account associated with this customer. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PrivacyHoldReasonId.description: The ID of the associated Privacy Hold Reason. This field is a relationship field.

ReferenceRecordId.description: The ID of the record marked for the Privacy Hold. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ReferenceRecordType.description: The type of object the record with the Privacy Hold is associated with. Possible values are: Account Contact Individual Lead User

RegisteredDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RegisteredDate.description: The date the Privacy Hold was added to the record.

special_access_rules:
This object is available for users with the Privacy Center license and the Manage Privacy Hold user permission.
